evidence.title: Host is outside the reviewed directory
evidence.detail: Actual host: example.org. Registrable domain: example.org. The query contains hostname text (www.dbs.com.sg); query text does not change the actual host. A query parameter is not proof that a redirect occurs. This check does not open the link or follow redirects; no final destination or website owner has been verified. The text mentions DBS, but this is not one of its exact hosts in this small directory. Unlisted services may be legitimate; missing coverage does not establish fraud or safety.

evidence.detail: This prototype does not send URL paths, queries, fragments or encoded values to a third party because they may contain private information or access tokens. The full link was not reputation-checked.
